text:
Maya: Quick syncproposing we split 'Adaptive Prefetch' into Phase A and Phase B so runtime/infra/security can sign off. Phase A = warm routing + KV caching, no tenant secrets. Phase B = tenant prefetch + private pilot (KMS/HSM + audit). Need acceptance criteria, sizing, rollout owners, blockers. cc @Jordan @Priya @Ken
Jordan: For Phase A what's the p95 target? 200ms for cold misses seems optimistic. Need fallback to variant-B when cache miss storms hit.
Priya: Sizing q: how many concurrent prewarm workers? If Phase A uses shared GPUs, reserve ~20% burst. I'll need a QPS profile.
Ken: Phase B requires KMS integration, audit logs, egress rules. Confirm Phase A stays no-customer-data to simplify review. :thinking_face:
Maya: Confirmed. Phase A explicitly no customer secrets; Phase B touches tenant secrets. I'll update the spec.
Jordan: Runtime asks: default KV TTL 10m (tunable). Canary toggles per-tenant + fallback to model-variant-B when latency exceeds threshold. I'll add a perf regression test and example curl.
Priya: Canary + toggles ok. Deployment windows: low-traffic weekday mornings. Who owns rollback playbook? infra or eng oncall?
Maya: Product owns rollout plan; eng (Jordan) owns rollback runbook and tests; infra (Priya) owns capacity reservations; security (Ken) owns Phase B checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Adaptive Prefetch Carveout triage" Mon 10:00 invites: Maya, Jordan, Priya, Ken, Alex
Jordan: I'll draft runtime runbook and perf harness by Friday and demo at triage.
Priya: Post the expected QPS shape by EOD and I'll produce a sizing table.
Ken: I'll draft security checklist for Phase B (KMS, audit, HSM ops, private subnet rules) and flag redlines by next Wed.
Alex: Product should define Phase A acceptance: e.g., <5% perf regression and toggles per-tenant with <1% error rate for QA signoff.
Maya: Action items recap: Jordan -> runtime runbook + perf tests (Fri). Priya -> capacity numbers + windows (Tue). Ken -> Phase B security checklist (Wed). Maya -> update spec + acceptance criteria + schedule triage.
Jordan: Also adding a script to simulate cache stampede and verify fallback.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll post sizing before the meeting if I get traffic shape.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll post the updated spec in #docs and ping here when live. If Mon 10 doesn't work for anyone suggest another slot.
